source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with layered ink-wash mountains, mist-filled valleys, pine and bamboo vegetation, small architectural retreats, streams and rocky banks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: background_grand_mountain
motifs.description: Large distant mountain mass occupying the upper-right background, with rounded overlapping peaks, pale ink wash, darker cun texture strokes, and a soft misty base.
must_preserve: dense black-gray texture strokes on ridges
subtle tonal variations across the mountain folds

motifs.name: left_distant_blue_hills
motifs.description: Low distant hills and rocky ridges on the left middle distance, including pale blue-green accent peaks and faint gray ink slopes emerging from mist.

motifs.name: mid_slope_pine_grove
motifs.description: Cluster of dark pines rooted on a midground rocky terrace, with surrounding rounded rocks and a narrow pale path or watercourse cutting through the slope.
must_preserve: dark upright trunks with fine branch lines
narrow pale winding passage through the rocks

motifs.name: cliffside_pavilion_hamlet
motifs.description: Small pavilion and house group tucked into the right midground hillside, with angled roofs, railings, pale walls, nearby leafless trees, and red blossom accents.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry with muted blue-gray roof washes
thin architectural linework for walls and railings
bare branching trees around the buildings
red blossom or berry dots as color accents
rocky hillside cradle around the structures

motifs.name: winding_stair_ravine
motifs.description: Narrow ravine descending through the right-center rocks, marked by a stepped path, dark bare trees, and steep enclosing rock walls.
must_preserve: soft wash transitions into surrounding mist

motifs.name: central_mist_reed_belt
motifs.description: Horizontal central band of pale mist and dense vertical reeds or bamboo-like vegetation separating the middle hills from the lower valley.
must_preserve: white unpainted mist band with irregular edges
layered atmospheric separation between foreground and midground

motifs.name: lower_left_waterside_retreat
motifs.description: Quiet lower-left waterside scene with a small pavilion or hut, bamboo grove, still water, low rocks, and a slender footbridge crossing the stream.
must_preserve: simple hut roof and thin support posts
dense bamboo leaves and stalks at left
slender horizontal bridge line with small supports
low shoreline rocks and bank contours
delicate bare branch reaching over the water

motifs.name: foreground_right_rocky_bank
motifs.description: Large foreground rocky riverbank on the lower right, formed from sweeping rounded boulders, dark crevices, shrubs, and layered shoreline rocks at the water's edge.
must_preserve: dense dry-brush texture and dark ink crevices
small shrubs and leafy bushes at the base
pale water edge with soft reflections

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
